Four merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `restBaseUrl` under `src`, most recent first:

1. **#630** (commit `9556d5a0`, 2026-09-21): removed `restBaseUrl` from the import and the `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/Location?_summary=data\`)` call in `src/stock-locations/stock-locations-table.component.tsx`.
2. **#616** (commit `390dc57d`, 2026-09-02): removed the `import { isDesktop, restBaseUrl, useSession }` line in `src/stock-reports/report-list/stock-reports.component.tsx` and replaced it with a version that adds `userHasAccess`.
3. **#542** (commit `c9d7c101`, 2026-05-17): added `restBaseUrl` stock-item and patient search URLs in `src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx`.
4. **#541** (commit `c67e4706`, 2026-05-05): replaced the `${restBaseUrl}/stockmanagement/userrolescope${isNew ...}` URL line in `src/stock-user-role-scopes/stock-user-role-scopes.resource.ts`.

Dates are the commit dates from `list_commits`; Falkon gave no separate merge timestamps. The history is the default branch, with HEAD at `9777f6d4` (#683). I took the list from commits touching `src` since 2026-04-14, which gave 16 commits.

Commits I ruled out from their diffs: #683, #636, #684-era dashboard and print changes (#622, #605), the SCSS-only commits, #567, #562, #553 (rspack), #528, #514 and #552 (vitest).

Two checks are weaker than the others:
- **#661** (`12a14555`, workspace v2 migration) produced a diff too large to read in full, and I could not open the saved copy. I checked four of the touched files (`stock-items-table`, `stock-reports.component`, `add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace`, `create-stock-report.workspace`). None changed a `restBaseUrl` line. The commit message says the `handleMutate` call sites and URL prefixes are unchanged, so I excluded it. A full check would need the diff read in pieces.
- **#552** (vitest): no test file under `src` contains `restBaseUrl` at either side of the commit, so I excluded it on that basis.
